When you switch AI "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"tools, start a new chat, or move to another computer, the next AI can continue from the recorded sta"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ls, start a new chat, or move to another computer, the next AI can continue from the recorded state."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Baton is useful when you do not write code yourself but use AI for a long-running project. You repea"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"t less context, lose fewer unfinished tasks, and can check whether work was really committed and pus"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ss context, lose fewer unfinished tasks, and can check whether work was really committed and pushed."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> Baton is not an AI, a cloud drive, or a cloud service. It is not a background program. It is a set"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" of project rules, templates, and scripts that AI tools read and follow only when you give a Baton c"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ject rules, templates, and scripts that AI tools read and follow only when you give a Baton command."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## When Baton helps"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Switch AI tools:** use Cursor yesterday, then let Codex or Claude Code continue today without ex"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"plaining everything again.
- **Switch computers:** finish at the office, pull the project at home, a"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"nd bring the progress and warnings with it.
- **Start a new chat:** when a conversation becomes too "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"long or loses context, the new chat can read the current task and last handoff.
- **Maintain a long "},{"id":"p8s5","text":"project:** keep decisions, rules, and pending work outside temporary chat history.
- **Avoid missed "},{"id":"p8s6","text":"Git steps:** after `clock out`, Baton requires commit and push checks, followed by remote revision v"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"erification.
- **Avoid repeated mistakes:** save verified pitfalls and long-term decisions so the ne"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"xt AI reads them before changing the project."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Baton cannot guarantee that an AI never makes mistakes. It also does not replace GitHub. It gives pr"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"oject facts a stable home and asks the AI to verify claims with real files and Git results."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Understand the two installation levels"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Level | How often | Where it goes | What it does |
|---|---:|---|---|
| User level | Once on each "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"computer | Skill folders for your Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code user | Teaches all three AI tools c"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ommands such as `Baton init` and `clock in` |
| Project level | Once for each project | Inside the p"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"roject folder | Creates project memory, handoffs, and entry files that can travel through Git |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**Recommended: install the user level first, then run `Baton init` once in every long-running projec"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"commended: install the user level first, then run `Baton init` once in every long-running project.**"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"One user-level installer prepares Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code together. "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"- PowerShell: <https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/scripting/install/installing-powershell-on-win"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"erShell: <https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/scripting/install/installing-powershell-on-windows>"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Step 2: Put Baton on this computer"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"First, check whether the default folder already exists:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- If the result is `False`, this is a first installation. An old session may not know about the newly installed Skill."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## Project files and privacy"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"`docs/ai_memory/` stores tasks, handoffs, decisions, design rules, and pitfalls. `.baton/config.json"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"` and `.baton/manifest.json` help restore and verify project setup. `.baton/runtime/baton-closeout.m"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"js` and `.baton/runtime/baton-public-update.mjs` are managed runtimes that travel with Git; they con"},{"id":"p37s4","text":"tain Baton closeout and fixed-public-update logic, not project content. These files normally go into"},{"id":"p37s5","text":" Git with the project so different AI tools and computers can share them."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"`.baton/local/` belongs only to the current computer and should not be committed. Baton templates pr"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"epare ignore rules for these machine-local files."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"Keep these points in mind:"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"- Never put API keys, tokens, passwords, or private keys in chat handoffs or project memory.
- If th"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"e project contains sensitive information, use a private Git repository that you control. Baton does "},{"id":"p40s3","text":"not change a repository from public to private or the reverse.
- User-level installation copies Bato"},{"id":"p40s4","text":"n Skills. It does not upload your project.
- Installing or initializing Baton does not automatically"},{"id":"p40s5","text":" change your product code."}],"truncated":true}
